svg.aria-label: One run over four turns. System 2 calls tools through a guard, which refuses a dangerous call; every turn goes into a journal; System 1 reads a cut of the session built by code, calls three turns in a row stuck and nudges System 2; when System 2's context passes the threshold, the turns fold into the State.
svg.text: the session cut, built by code
nudge: act on what you found
turns 1-4 folded into the State, written as edits
